status: qualification proposal only; no production host capability claimed
purpose: Permit a verified add-on recovery entry to run briefly after the complete companion Job Object terminates, without allowing that companion to escape its containment.
requirements: The host owns and launches the recovery process outside the exact companion Job Object; the companion receives no breakaway permission.
The host verifies the executable entry against the immutable artifact and binds the owner's PID plus creation time.
Readiness is acknowledged before reversible state changes become eligible for crash recovery.
The recovery entry interprets opaque state; window identities, expected styles and placement semantics remain add-on-owned.
A fixed budget bounds post-exit execution; completion, rejection and failed recovery are observable.
This proposal does not imply launch ratification or modifications to DEC-0157.
localEvidence: src/recovery.cpp: StartGuardian readiness and PID+creation-time binding
src/runtime.cpp: context detection and safe tray fallback
tests/windows.test.mjs: parent termination versus complete Job Object termination
